title: Special Lagrangian smoothings, Calabi ansatz and stability conditions
summary: As part of his work on special Lagrangian (sLag) submanifolds with isolated conical singularities, Joyce proved a criterion for the existence of sLag smoothings, along a small variation of complex structure, for the union of two connected, compact, embedded sLags, with the same phase, intersecting transversely.
